scenes.en: One pop can hurt an eye.
scenes.say: Party popper pointed at someone's face? One pop can seriously hurt an eye.

scenes.en: The front of the eye is thin and delicate. Fast paper, plastic or a cork can scratch or bruise it.
scenes.say: The front of your eye is thin and delicate. A fast piece of paper, plastic or a cork can scratch it, or bruise the inside of the eye.

scenes.en: Point poppers up, away from everyone.
scenes.ta: பாப்பரை மேலே, யாரும் இல்லாத பக்கம் வெடியுங்கள்
scenes.say: Do point party poppers straight up, away from everyone, and hold them at arm's length.

scenes.en: A popping cork can fly fast enough to injure an eye. Cover it with a towel, point it away.
scenes.ta: பாட்டில் மூடி வேகமாக பறந்து கண்ணை காயப்படுத்தும்
scenes.say: Did you know? A popping cork can fly fast enough to cause a serious eye injury. Cover it with a towel, and point it away from people.

scenes.en: Arm's length, safety glasses, a bucket of water, an adult beside.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகளுடன் பெரியவர் இருக்க வேண்டும்; பாதுகாப்பு கண்ணாடி அணியுங்கள்
scenes.say: For children, keep sparklers at arm's length, use safety glasses, keep a bucket of water nearby, and always have an adult beside them.

scenes.en: Don't rub, press or pull out anything stuck in the eye.
scenes.say: If something hits the eye, don't rub it, don't press it, and don't try to pull anything out.

scenes.en: Pain, bleeding, blurred vision or a burn: see an eye specialist now.
scenes.ta: வலி, ரத்தம், மங்கலான பார்வை: உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்!
scenes.say: Pain, bleeding, blurred vision or a burn? Cover the eye gently with a clean cloth, and see an eye specialist right away.

scenes.en: Start the new year with an eye test.
scenes.say: Celebrate safely, and start the new year with an eye test for the whole family.
